prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured's policyholder regarding a low-speed collision in a shopping center parking lot. Caller reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side door while the caller was stopped in a parking space. Caller states no police report was filed. Photos requested and assigned to file.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Claimant reports neck and lower back discomfort following the impact and is seeking medical evaluation. Claimant states a back strain was diagnosed at urgent care. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says they prefer to handle the claim directly. Explained the claims process and the policy's medical payments coverage.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by claimant. Visible damage to rear quarter panel and driver door consistent with a sideswipe at low speed. Vehicle scheduled for estimate at a preferred repair facility. Requested the urgent care visit notes and itemized bill from claimant with signed authorization.

Entry 4: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability position. Carrier acknowledged claim and is reviewing the parking lot video provided by the property manager. Preliminary view is that the other driver backed out without yielding. Reserve set for property damage and bodily injury pending medical documentation.

Entry 5: Received medical records from urgent care confirming diagnosis of lumbar strain with recommended rest and physical therapy referral. Claimant informed that the bodily injury evaluation will proceed once the treatment plan is complete. Advised claimant that they may consult an attorney at any time and that the adjuster will continue to communicate directly. Follow-up scheduled.
